question: Does fresh three-turn replanning after every atomic action beat the validated cached-plan three-turn search when they play directly against each other on new procedural duel maps, with acceptable native CPU latency?
arena: Classic Generic procedural_v2 11x9, two players, 2400-action finite horizon with material adjudication flagged nonterminal
agents: Replanned seat forks the exact current game before each atomic action, checks complete BatchObservation and local legal-action ordering, runs native three-turn search root beam256/top8/opponent beam64/followup beam32 on the fork and executes that legal action in the live game. Cached opponent uses the existing native three-turn SearchAgent with the same search parameters and its whole-turn plan cache. Rotate seats on each independent seed. No frozen direct opponent in this head-to-head; it is a distinct test from seeds6490000/6491000.
analysis: Report all 256 games, terminal/action-limit counts, replanned wins for each seat, paired per-map net of the two rotated games, and an exact two-sided independent-map sign test. Also time each active player's full turn by summing every action-selection duration; report median and p95 native one-core milliseconds by controller, number of measured turns and descriptive ratio. Because the agents visit different states, these timings are not a same-state browser WASM benchmark. Show worst-case sensitivity to any adjudicated game; never silently relabel an action-limit result as terminal.
gate: For further promotion research, require zero action-limit adjudications in both arms, replanned wins at least64/128 in EACH seat, paired independent-map exact sign p<0.05 favoring replanning, median replanned whole-turn native CPU time below250ms and p95 below1000ms. If outcome passes but runtime fails, optimize the exact algorithm and retest on a NEW window; do not deploy the slow implementation. This is not a trained-student or Site promotion gate. Any new rated/browser agent additionally needs disjoint direct-model head-to-head, Online Default/Classic Slay profiles, browser runtime/UX and owner-private publication checks.
resources: Heavy games only on SSH server fedora-toolbox, one CPU pinned15 nice19, Rayon/BLAS capped, 1800-second hard timeout, tiny JSON, no GPU or preemption. Never touch the dirty remote original repo.
